title: Juicy Canadian Cheese Burger
description: A umami, crisp, brunch mood Canadian dish featuring instant yeast and lacto-vegetarian-friendly cheese. Inspired by the classic cheeseburger, this recipe adds a twist with the use of Canadian cheese and sashimi-cut vegetables.
instructions: Soften 1/4 cup of instant yeast in 1/4 cup of warm water.
In a large bowl, mix together 1 cup of all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup of whole wheat flour, and 1 teaspoon of salt.
Gradually add 1/2 cup of warm water and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Divide the dough into 4 equal portions and shape each portion into a ball.
Use a rolling pin to flatten each ball into a disk.
Place a beef patty in the center of each disk, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Top each patty with 1-2 slices of Canadian cheese, depending on the size of the patty.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the burger.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat and add 1 tablespoon of oil.
Cook the burgers for 4-5 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown and cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast 4 hamburger buns on the skillet or in a toaster.
Assemble the burgers by spreading 1-2 tablespoons of mayonnaise or ketchup on each bun, followed by a cooked burger, a few slices of tomato, a few slices of lettuce, and finally the top bun.
